items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Papa Lemon, this old piece by Blue Left Texas Lopey Like a Mule.

ctx.x: What were some of the tunes you listened to?

Well, uh... Papa Lemon, this old piece by Blue Left Texas Lopey Like a Mule. I gave y'all that about the last time he always said. And then another one. Yeah. That's another one that he was playing. Sitting on top of the wall and all those old pieces.
